notes:
### New

- **Email alerts.** A new action sends an email when something happens to a UPS: the power goes out or comes back, the battery runs low, a test fails. It goes to your account's email, or to another address once it confirms by a link. Try the new template "Email me when the power goes out". Every plan.
- **Text message alerts (Connect Pro).** The same alerts as a text message to a phone number, which confirms once with a code. Up to 50 texts a month.
- **Tescom Connect for Linux servers.** A package with NUT and the cloud agent, without the desktop app, for any Linux with systemd: AlmaLinux and RHEL 8 and 9, Rocky, Debian 10+, Ubuntu 20.04+, Raspberry Pi OS and others. Install it, then run `sudo tescom-connect setup` to find the UPS and `sudo tescom-connect register KEY` to add it to your account. Available as .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz on the downloads page.

### Improved

- **Changing the UPS on this computer.** A different UPS set up on the same computer no longer keeps the previous one's serial number, warranty and plan when it reports no serial of its own. A UPS's Settings has "Not this UPS" next to a serial it didn't report itself.
- **Find my UPS** says so when the UPS answers with empty readings (it is off, or its USB bridge is stuck), instead of only that it couldn't read it.

### Fixed

- On a Mac, setting the UPS up again after another build of the app had set it up left the old service running, so the new UPS was never shown ("This UPS isn't there any more").
- The line under a UPS's state no longer overlaps the sentence above it when the steps to try are shown.
